EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM factory_settlement_detail d WHERE d.rental_order_id=o.id AND d.detail_status!='cancelled' AND JSON_CONTAINS(d.source_allocation_snapshot_json,JSON_OBJECT('allocationId',a.id,'suborderId',a.payment_channel_suborder_id),'$.sources'))

(o.order_status='completed' OR (o.order_status IN ('user_cancelled','cancelled') AND o.accept_status='accepted' AND o.cancel_type='user_cancel_rule') OR (o.order_status='cancelled' AND )) AND o.updated_at<#{cutoff} AND f.updated_at<#{cutoff} AND f.freight_status IN ('settled','cancelled') AND o.deposit_paid_amount_fen=o.deposit_refunded_amount_fen+o.deposit_deducted_amount_fen AND o.service_fee_fen=0 AND o.total_paid_amount_fen>o.total_refunded_amount_fen AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_allocation a WHERE a.rental_order_id=o.id AND NOT ) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental_overdue_fee fee WHERE fee.rental_order_id=o.id AND fee.fee_status!='effective') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_reservation r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.reservation_status IN ('held','paid_locked','renting','overdue_holding','disputed_holding')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refund_order r JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.id=r.payment_channel_suborder_id WHERE s.rental_order_id=o.id AND (r.refund_status NOT IN ('cancelled','success') OR r.updated_at>=#{cutoff})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_deduction d WHERE d.rental_order_id=o.id AND (d.deduction_status='pending' OR d.updated_at>=#{cutoff})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_price_adjustment a WHERE a.rental_order_id=o.id AND a.updated_at>=#{cutoff})

o.order_status='completed' AND o.acceptance_status='accepted' AND o.completed_at<#{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_order_settlement d WHERE d.custom_order_id=o.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_after_sale_request a WHERE a.active_order_guard=o.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refund_order r WHERE r.biz_order_type='custom_order' AND r.biz_order_id=o.id AND (r.refund_status NOT IN ('success','cancelled') OR r.updated_at>=#{cutoff})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_relation r JOIN admin_case c ON c.id=r.admin_case_id WHERE r.relation_type='custom_order' AND r.relation_id=o.id AND c.case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled'))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT o.factory_id FROM rental_order o JOIN rental_order_freight_account f ON f.rental_order_id=o.id WHERE o.factory_id>#{after} AND AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM factory_settlement_batch b WHERE b.factory_id=o.factory_id AND b.settlement_period_end=#{cutoff}) UNION SELECT o.factory_id FROM custom_order o WHERE o.factory_id>#{after} AND AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM factory_settlement_batch b WHERE b.factory_id=o.factory_id AND b.settlement_period_end=#{cutoff}) ORDER BY factory_id LIMIT 100

SELECT o.id,o.buyer_user_id buyer,p.owner_user_id owner,o.factory_id factory,o.order_status status,o.rent_paid_amount_fen rent,o.rent_refunded_amount_fen rentReturned, o.deposit_paid_amount_fen deposit,o.deposit_refunded_amount_fen depositReturned,f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen freight,f.refunded_amount_fen freightReturned, f.approved_total_amount_fen approved,f.online_settle_amount_fen reimbursement,o.rent_deducted_amount_fen cancellation,o.deposit_deducted_amount_fen depositDeducted, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM factory_settlement_detail d WHERE d.rental_order_id=o.id AND d.detail_status!='cancelled') incremental, AS `terminated` FROM rental_order o JOIN factory_profile p ON p.id=o.factory_id JOIN rental_order_freight_account f ON f.rental_order_id=o.id WHERE o.factory_id=#{factory} AND ORDER BY o.id
SELECT id FROM rental_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM factory_profile WHERE id=#{factory} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM factory_settlement_batch WHERE factory_id=#{factory} AND settlement_period_end=#{end})

SELECT a.id allocationId,a.payment_order_id paymentOrderId,s.id suborderId,p.payment_scene scene,s.factory_wechat_account_id accountId,s.sub_mchid_snapshot merchant,s.channel_sub_transaction_id transactionId, m.subject_name_snapshot accountName,COALESCE(m.settlement_account_masked,CONCAT('****',RIGHT(s.sub_mchid_snapshot,4))) masked,CASE WHEN s.profit_sharing_flag=1 AND s.payment_status='success' AND m.factory_id=o.factory_id THEN s.channel_suborder_status ELSE 'unsupported' END state,s.paid_amount_fen paid,s.refunded_amount_fen refunded, a.rent_allocated_amount_fen cashRentFen,a.deposit_allocated_amount_fen cashDepositFen,a.freight_prepaid_allocated_fen cashFreightFen,a.coupon_discount_allocated_fen coupon, a.compensation_allocated_amount_fen compensation,a.service_fee_allocated_fen+a.custom_goods_allocated_amount_fen other,a.total_allocated_amount_fen total FROM payment_allocation a JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=a.rental_order_id LEFT JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.id=a.payment_channel_suborder_id AND s.rental_order_id=a.rental_order_id AND s.payment_order_id=a.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=s.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN factory_wechat_merchant_account m ON m.id=s.factory_wechat_account_id AND m.factory_id=s.factory_id WHERE a.rental_order_id=#{id} AND NOT ORDER BY s.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id,r.payment_channel_suborder_id suborderId,r.rent_refund_amount_fen rent,r.deposit_refund_amount_fen deposit,r.freight_refund_amount_fen freight, r.custom_goods_refund_amount_fen+r.compensation_refund_amount_fen+r.service_fee_refund_fen other,r.refund_amount_fen amount FROM refund_order r JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.id=r.payment_channel_suborder_id WHERE s.rental_order_id=#{id} AND r.refund_status='success' ORDER BY r.id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(overdue_rent_amount_fen),0) FROM factory_settlement_detail WHERE rental_order_id=#{id} AND detail_status!='cancelled'

SELECT id,adjustment_type kind,fund_component component,source_id sourceId,amount_fen amount FROM order_price_adjustment WHERE rental_order_id=#{id} AND adjustment_status='applied' UNION ALL SELECT id,IF(deduction_type='overdue',source_type,deduction_type),fund_component,source_id,amount_fen FROM order_deduction WHERE rental_order_id=#{id} AND deduction_status='confirmed' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_channel_suborder SET channel_suborder_status='sharing',version=version+1,updated_at=#{batch.at} WHERE id=#{chain.source.suborderId} AND channel_suborder_status IN ('paid_frozen','partially_refunded')
mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.buyer_user_id buyer,f.owner_user_id owner, o.factory_id factory,o.commission_rate_bps_snapshot rate,o.custom_goods_paid_amount_fen goods,o.delivery_fee_paid_fen freight,o.refunded_amount_fen refunded FROM custom_order o JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=o.factory_id WHERE o.factory_id=#{factory} AND ORDER BY o.id
SELECT id FROM custom_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.id allocationId,p.id paymentOrderId,s.id suborderId,p.payment_scene scene, m.id accountId,s.sub_mchid_snapshot merchant,s.channel_sub_transaction_id transactionId,m.subject_name_snapshot accountName,COALESCE(m.settlement_account_masked,CONCAT('****',RIGHT(s.sub_mchid_snapshot,4))) masked, s.channel_suborder_status state,s.paid_amount_fen paid,s.refunded_amount_fen refunded,a.rent_allocated_amount_fen cashRentFen,a.deposit_allocated_amount_fen cashDepositFen, a.freight_prepaid_allocated_fen cashFreightFen,a.coupon_discount_allocated_fen coupon,a.compensation_allocated_amount_fen compensation,a.custom_goods_allocated_amount_fen other,a.total_allocated_amount_fen total FROM custom_order o JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=o.payment_order_id AND p.buyer_user_id=o.buyer_user_id AND p.payment_scene='custom_order_full_payment' JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.payment_order_id=p.id AND s.custom_order_id=o.id AND s.factory_id=o.factory_id AND s.payment_status='success' AND s.profit_sharing_flag=1 JOIN payment_allocation a ON a.payment_channel_suborder_id=s.id AND a.custom_order_id=o.id AND a.payment_order_id=p.id JOIN factory_wechat_merchant_account m ON m.id=s.factory_wechat_account_id AND m.factory_id=o.factory_id WHERE o.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(custom_goods_refund_amount_fen),0) goods, COALESCE(SUM(freight_refund_amount_fen),0) freight FROM refund_order WHERE payment_channel_suborder_id=#{sub} AND refund_status='success'
